defectsFoundByLooking.finding: The hidden attribute is inert on this kit for any component web/shell.css gives an explicit display. .pill is inline-flex, .prov is inline-flex, .state is flex, and none of them has a [hidden] rule, so `el.hidden = true` does nothing. The first screenshot pass showed the honest-empty block rendering ABOVE fourteen populated rows, and the Demo records pill rendering on empty-city.
defectsFoundByLooking.evidence: web/shell.css:688 and :716 carry .stage[hidden] and .stage-esc[hidden] rules. Those two components were patched one at a time when someone hit this before; nothing else was.
defectsFoundByLooking.fix: A show(el, on) helper in web/app.js sets the attribute and forces the display, and the static markup carries style="display:none" beside the attribute so the pre-script state agrees. A ui test asserts every toggle goes through it and was proven to fail when one toggle was regressed to a bare .hidden assignment.
defectsFoundByLooking.properFix: one [hidden] { display: none } rule in the kit, which is lane B76's file this wave
